note: OoTR item names with the remake item actors each one maps to. adv marks logic progression. mode: actor, tiers, generic, bundle, bottle, shop, logic or none. actor is the identity used for a chest Drop__DropActor and for tiers it is the first copy. tiers lists one actor per progressive copy in order. world lists other actors that carry the same item. qty is the amount the actor delivers. conf: exact = same specific thing, convention = matched by naming only, approx = same family but the amount differs. via lists where the item can be granted with seen = observed in the dump data, partial = some tiers observed, guess = actor exists but never observed there. Identifiers only.
